name: S&B Cold Air Intake with Dry Extendable Filter (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Bobknight
visible.title: Been using S&B for years
visible.body: Just installed the S&B cold air intake and it's a night-and-day difference. The install was super straightforward—everything actually lines up like it's supposed to, and you can knock it out in the driveway with basic tools in under an hour. ?Right away, you notice crisper throttle response and a nice, deep tone under acceleration without any annoying drone on the highway. ?More importantly, it actually protects your engine. S&B filters down to around 0.5 to 1 micron, meaning dirt and fine dust stay out of your cylinders. If you're looking at K&N instead, skip it—their thin, oiled-cotton gauze lets way too much fine grit pass through (turning your oil into liquid sandpaper over time), and it's way too easy to over-oil them and ruin your MAF sensor. Dont believe me? Use you phone and research it. Heck use AI to do it for you and do comparison. ?S&B gives you great airflow without sacrificing filtration. 10/10 worth the money.
visible.product: S&B Cold Air Intake with Oiled Cleanable Cotton Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)
